title: Lantern Drift
tagline: Float paper lanterns that hum as they rise over a night lake.
how_to: Tap the lake to release a lantern (left is low, right is high). Turn sound on.
description: A dark lake under a moon. Each tap releases a paper lantern whose pitch comes from where you tapped. It drifts up and sways, flaring and chiming a pentatonic note every few seconds, so overlapping lanterns weave slow, never-repeating melodies. Watch the reflections in the water.
spark: Lanterns taken literally: glowing paper lanterns as the voices of a slow generative song.
proud_of: Every lantern keeps its own tempo, so the music drifts in and out of phase like real floating lights.
